versions.changelog:
Initial release — effortlessly generate daily standup reports by analyzing real development activity.

- Automatically gathers and summarizes git commits, pull request activity, and issue tracker updates for a chosen time range.
- Groups related work, interprets commit messages, and identifies active branches and work-in-progress.
- Highlights blockers such as failing CI, unreviewed PRs, and merge conflicts.
- Produces structured standup reports with clear yesterday/today/blockers sections, tailored to common Scrum/Agile team rituals.
- Customizable for different users, repositories, and time ranges.
